rules.rule: Never interpret route file names ourselves or edit generated route tree text. Route structure comes only from TanStack's own crawl, and trees are emitted only by TanStack's buildRouteTree.
Nothing may write into the user's routes directory. Generator writes go through the read-only or in-memory fs adapters.
Every user-facing error or warning says what went wrong and how to fix it (the file, the config key, or the exact command).
